valiant.name: Valiant
valiant.blurb: Stands between the flock and the foe. Sturdy, close-in, hard to move.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.blurb: Keeps watch on the wall and sees danger first. Fights at a distance.

expositor.name: Expositor
expositor.blurb: Opens the Word carefully and plainly. Strong skills, light armor.

shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.blurb: Feeds, guards and seeks the sheep. The best healing in a company.

steward.name: Steward
steward.role: Support · faithful with what is given
steward.blurb: Manages what belongs to another, faithfully. Keeps a company supplied.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.blurb: A stranger and exile passing through. Light, fast, hard to pin down.
